_README: Copy this file to datasets/real/datasets.json, delete the _README and _notes keys, then fill in every value marked FILL_IN.
I could read the SVS pages but NOT view the images, so legends and layouts below are UNVERIFIED.
For each dataset: download 1 still (or use `python -m pipeline.build frames video.mp4 --times 0,99%`),
run `python -m pipeline.build detect <still> --vmin A --vmax B --out out/debug.png`, open out/debug.png,
and only keep the dataset if meanΔE < 3 and the warnings list is empty (or understood).

datasets.title: Night lights change, 2012 to 2023
datasets.description: Change in night-time light seen from space. Purple = more light, orange = less light.

credit.text: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio, Change in Night Lights between 2012 and 2023 (EIC version, SVS 5313)

story.intro: FILL_IN: your words. Why light at night matters.

datasets._notes: The EIC version is 7680x2160 (32:9) with zoomed inset panels: you MUST set extract.map_bbox to the main flat-map panel only. Check whether the change map shows a legend; if not, this dataset needs a manual legend (see README).

datasets.title: Fine particulate matter (PM2.5)
datasets.description: Near-surface fine particles from NASA's GEOS-CF model.

credit.text: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio and Global Modeling and Assimilation Office, GEOS-CF (SVS 5151 / 5533)

datasets._notes: Page 5151 was NOT fetched by me; only linked from 5533. Verify it is a flat map with a colorbar. If its colorbar is a separate image, set extract.legend_image and legend_orientation.

datasets.title: Sea surface temperature
datasets.description: Ocean temperature, with currents drawn on top.

credit.text: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio, Global Sea Surface Currents and Temperature (SVS 3912)

datasets._notes: Page 3912 was NOT fetched by me. Current streaks drawn over the colours are thin lines, which the pipeline fills in; check the debug picture.
